[RHIM.8.1] The integrator drives hydration through three engine
operations:

| Operation | Obligation it serves |
|---|---|
| assert-with-TTL | assert each hydrated fact with the `retain:` TTL (RHIM.3.3, RHIM.6) |
| set-hydration-budget | override the global budget after load (RHIM.5.1.3) |
| schema-lookup-by-name | resolve `HydrationComplete` / `HydratedSample` / `CallError` (RHIM.4.1) |
